scenarios.description: Suppliers falter: deliveries to the cafe almost stop arriving, so stock runs down until the failure clears — and staff count stock far more often as shortages bite.
scenarios.name: supplier_failure

scenarios.description: Staff call in sick: far fewer cafe staff clock in for a shift. No catalogue has a dedicated absence event type, so a sick day manifests as missing clock-ins.
scenarios.name: staff_sick_day

scenarios.description: Demand surges across the board: cafe orders, ecommerce orders, gym check-ins and enrolments, and logistics shipments all jump.
scenarios.name: demand_spike

scenarios.description: Customers leave in a wave: SaaS churn and gym membership cancellations spike.
scenarios.name: churn_wave

scenarios.description: Payments start failing everywhere: SaaS and gym payment failures spike. (Ecommerce failures are a payload outcome of payment_processed, and clinic claim denials a payload outcome of claim_adjudicated, so neither is a selectable event type a multiplier can target.)
scenarios.name: payment_failure_wave
